notes.title: Update 1.12
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I hope you are enjoying The Ruins!

We've fixed a few issues that have been brought to our attention. This update is a focus on clarity. A few users have noted the game is a bit blurry, so we've improved the visuals. Everything should be sharp and crisp now.

Changes:
-Removed Film Gain effect from all scenes
-Replaced FXAA with MSAA
-Tinkered with the default resolution

Changes from 1.11:
-Fixed rocks not making sound

In addition to this, the game should also run slightly smoother. 

Hope you guys enjoy this new update. ːgemartifactː
